source_evidence: Player exact 'Of course.' answers the councillor's immediate request for permission to retain copies of evidence. Scope limited to displayed Kestrel material for confidential review; prior D315 faithful-copy precedent and D326 presentation govern. Routine competent clerks complete supervised copying in actual scene, no arbitrary roll, money, transfer of originals, opening samples or approval of diplomacy. Prior sponsorship and proposed safeguards preserved, no further negotiated concession. D326~12:35 private audience chamber, Royal Palace, Orsaven. V, Mara, Cirren, Fenar present; coach/four horses at Copper Hart. At the councillor's specific request for confidential copies, player exact 'Of course.' authorizes ordinary supervised copying of Kestrel documents shown in this audience, not transfer of originals, physical samples, publication or broader disclosure. Councillor thanks V; palace secretary and available clerks complete one faithful certified transcription set of the displayed original regional bureau directive naming Corven Nask, EVERMARCH and CLEAR WILL orders, transfer/requisition ledger, two false-discharge folios, trial/injury packet, and relevant witness summaries/voluntarily presented notes. Copies certified as faithful, underlying seals/authenticity and merits not independently established. Original records remain V's custody, Mara retains notes, Fenar retains six sealed reagent vials and instrument; Cirren's private compact not included. No samples opened or transferred, no new private survivor identities disclosed beyond what was already authorized in this audience, no fee, roll or further V commitment. Ossent councillor retains confidential copies for his favorable recommendation of preliminary reciprocal verified frontier warnings/joint inquiries, safeguarding troop dispositions and existing Crown claims, suspend if misused. Will refer proposal through competent royal council; no agreed appointment date, royal assent, policy waiver, direct military liaison, binding treaty, funds/troops pledge or new commission. Existing Ossent condition remains unless actual Crown changes it. V limited messenger, original invitation delivered D325; receipt/credentials retained. Councillor knows personally presented Kestrel evidence and preliminary Orseld report; no proved link between raids and Veyr. D326 conditional hereditary recovery grant accepted, V signed instrument retained, zero acquisition price, actual title only after securing parcel/preserving ferrier access and verifying conditions; no expedition yet. Coris authenticated comparison packet in keeper's outgoing custody, dispatch/receipt/300gp assessment pending, Mara retains copy; western crossing48road+12rough miles approx3days each way, optional800gp field milestone unearned. Ferrymen's Share boatyard inquiry available; Quenwood life imprisonment upheld, restitution unpaid. Crown frontier commission remaining300+1300 contingent. Both magic commissions deposits260 paid, balance520 due upon actual completion target353; Serpent Dart unresolved. Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 +1 Shield equipped old shield retained Boots of Elvenkind; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40, breastplate/Insignia equipped; natural attacks+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging; mechanical greataxe unchanged. Mara/coach/horses healthy. Purse2049gp8sp6cp, rations21/feed28, LR0/6. Dice delegated until stop. Councillor concludes this portion of the audience, offers to send word of any actual royal decision through V's established Copper Hart address, no promised date or actual outgoing reply. Await V's further question or departure; no automatic next visit or accepted action.
